```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$inputs_path))
inputs <- readRDS(params$inputs_path)
```

## Snapshot

- Sites: `r inputs$n_sites`
- Observations (raw rows): `r inputs$n_obs_raw`
- Observations (filtered to active effort days): `r inputs$n_obs_filtered`
- Input schema version: `r inputs$schema_version`

## QC summary

```{r}
qc_totals <- data.frame(
  total_obs = sum(inputs$time_qc_summary$total_obs),
  parse_fail = sum(inputs$time_qc_summary$parse_fail),
  dst_gap = sum(inputs$time_qc_summary$dst_gap),
  backward_jumps = sum(inputs$time_qc_summary$backward_jumps)
)
knitr::kable(qc_totals)
```

## Time handling & limitations

Timezone configured: `r inputs$params$timezone`  
Backward-jump threshold (hours): `r inputs$params$time_qc$backward_jump_threshold_hours`

Datetime strings are parsed in the configured timezone. Values that fall into daylight saving gaps
or indicate backward jumps are flagged for review rather than automatically corrected.

```{r}
knitr::kable(inputs$time_qc_summary)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$time_qc_plot_path))
knitr::include_graphics(params$time_qc_plot_path)
```

```{r}
flagged_rows <- nrow(inputs$time_qc_flags)
if (flagged_rows > 0) {
  knitr::kable(utils::head(inputs$time_qc_flags, 20))
} else {
  cat("No time QC flags detected.")
}
```

## Event definition & spacing diagnostics

Independent events are defined by clustering detections of the same species at the same site
with a gap threshold of `r inputs$params$event_threshold_minutes` minutes.

```{r}
total_events <- sum(inputs$events_per_day$events)
median_gap <- median(inputs$event_spacing$gap_hours, na.rm = TRUE)
data.frame(
  total_events = total_events,
  median_gap_hours = round(median_gap, 2)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$event_spacing_path))
knitr::include_graphics(params$event_spacing_path)
```

## Limitations & assumptions

- Datetimes are interpreted in the configured timezone; DST gaps and clock resets are flagged, not corrected.
- Independent events depend on the gap threshold; sensitivity analysis is planned for later work.
- Diel proportions use `flash` as a day/night proxy and do not account for sunrise/sunset variation.
- RAI reflects relative detection rates, not absolute abundance.

## Provenance

Run outputs are stored under: `r params$run_dir`  
Run manifest: `r file.path(params$run_dir, "run_manifest.json")`  
Session info: `r file.path(params$run_dir, "session_info.txt")`
